required_semantics: Preserve absolute path strings and source-bound expected hashes, per-call CURRENT mapping/list/record aliases and original lookup/failure order, relative-path refusals and short circuits. Mutating stops/abort/record aliases midcall must affect the same subsequent operations.

For present markers preserve fresh canonical resolve and no-final-symlink open, regular/size/budget limits, complete authenticated bytes, fstat/lstat identity/stamp and growth checks; descriptor reuse alone misses pathname replacement.

For absent markers fresh lexists must detect dangling symlink as presence; retain all557 checks and seven abort paths in order on successful full invocation. A directory listing or stat-following substitute has different race/error/symlink behavior.

Preserve deadline, owner PID/birth/boot, lease/lock/custody/resource checks and exception propagation on the original owning thread/callback boundary. No historical observer receipt can stand in for current check.
